## Purpose

What problem does this change solve, and why is this approach appropriate?

## Related issues

Link related issues, or write "None". Use `Closes #123` only when this PR fully resolves that issue.

## Changes

Summarize the changes a reviewer needs to understand.

## Verification

List reproducible commands and their results, including relevant regression or failure cases.
Follow the [contribution guide](https://github.com/ashaveri/ashaveri/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#setup)
for build order and test environment. For checks not run or not applicable, state why.

## Compatibility and impact

Describe effects on callers, wire formats, stored receipts, verification results, and deployment
behavior. For a breaking change, include migration steps; otherwise state that there is no
compatibility impact.

## Checklist

These checks apply to maintainers and outside contributors alike. Leave an inapplicable item
unchecked and explain why in Verification.

- [ ] I followed the [contribution guide](https://github.com/ashaveri/ashaveri/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/ashaveri/ashaveri/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] The PR title and commits use Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Behavior changes have regression tests, including a case that fails without the change.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, error-code tables, schemas, and generated fixtures agree with the change.
- [ ] The description, diff, and attachments contain no credentials, signing keys, or private data.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through the
[private reporting form](https://github.com/ashaveri/ashaveri/security/advisories/new)
or the email address in the [security policy](https://github.com/ashaveri/ashaveri/security/policy)
before opening a public issue or PR about them.
